# tests/fixtures/

Public-domain content only.

`library-v1/` will hold the complete first-run library plus the worked examples from Spec 1 §9 (channels, Preset 1, the two-cue hymn list, stacks, machine settings). Every later spec's tests start from it (Spec 1 §10). The engine spike adds a fixture list of public-domain hymn lyrics over ProRes and HEVC backgrounds, with trims and one loop, plus a clapper fixture for A/V sync (Spec 4 §15). Keep media small; large soak media stays on the test bench, referenced by hash.
